violations.why: ISR may overwrite ch1 between the check at line 44 and the reset at line 45, so the reset acts on a stale condition.
Main writes 0 at line 45, the ISR overwrites it, and main then reads a value at line 65 that is not the 0 it wrote.
The ISR can change ch1 between the read at line 44 and the read at line 65, so the two reads see inconsistent values.
